wnnbt44c.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink - 180 cm
wnnbt44c.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Pink - 180 cm
wnnbt44c.sourceDescription: This cone-shaped PVC Artificial Christmas Tree brings modern elegance to your seasonal decor with its sleek and simple design. It enhances any living space or garden, creating a festive presence with minimal ornamentation and maximum impact. Its visually appealing structure can serve as a centerpiece for gatherings, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a stylish appearance that aligns with contemporary aesthetics. Quality PVC Build The tree is constructed from high-quality PVC, known for its durability and weather resistance, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The material ensures longevity while mimicking the lush, evergreen foliage of a real tree, lending a natural look to your decor. Versatile LED Lighting Equipped with flexible LED strip lights, this tree offers warm white illumination that can be adapted to various settings. The USB connection allows for convenient powering options, enabling usage in multiple environments without the need for traditional power adapters. Modern Design With clean lines and a minimalist form, it fits seamlessly into modern decor styles. The understated elegance enhances any space, allowing you to decorate creatively with ornaments or lights for a personalized touch. Easy Installation Requires simple assembly with a screwdriver, accommodating those with minimal DIY experience. The straightforward setup ensures that your holiday preparation is stress-free so you can focus on the festive activities. Indoor &Outdoor Use Suitable for living rooms, gardens, and terraces, this tree adds charm both inside and outside. Its weather-resistant build makes it a flexible addition to your holiday decorations, approachable for various settings and scenarios. Product Specifications Colour: Pink Material: PVC Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 93 cm Stand size: 40 x 40 cm Hinged construction for set up lightweight and break-resistant Number of PVC tips: 564 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 1000 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

g658phab.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 75 cm Wide - Green - 150 cm
g658phab.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period.
